name: efv-monorepo
description: EFV Unified Monorepo - Frontend (Next.js) & Backend (Express) in a Single Service

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix EFV-B install && npm --prefix EFV-F install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
